pr.body:
## Summary

Deploys the source-tested Shadow readiness ledger v2 into Genesis. Daily readiness remains deterministic and zero-model, while the dashboard now distinguishes design, technical, evidence, and operating maturity. Adds a deny-by-default Firebase profile and a locked CI workflow for both the control plane and app.

Closes #49.

## Tickets

| Ticket | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| #49 | Adopt the zero-model readiness ledger and Firebase profile | In Progress |

## Changes

- .github/workflows/ci.yml — locked Rust and application test gate
- .github/workflows/deterministic-dashboard.yml — schema-v2, scope-aware daily snapshot inputs and artifacts
- .shadow/ci/Cargo.lock — locked deterministic control-plane dependencies
- .shadow/ci/src/control_attest.rs — expiring human-control evidence command
- .shadow/ci/src/main.rs — control-attest command and updated verifier contract
- .shadow/ci/src/verify.rs — repository, GitHub, Firebase, GCP, evidence, and attestation observations
- .shadow/site/src/main.rs — schema-v2 import, scope application, conservative credit, four readiness histories
- .shadow/site/src/render.rs — four readiness measures and richer source/expiry detail
- README.md — continuous-readiness usage and cost boundary
- app/test/firestore.rules.test.ts — executable deny-by-default Firebase rule test
- docs/readiness-ledger.md — agents, measures, export contract, and path to 100
- docs/readiness-snapshot.schema.json — vendor-neutral JSON Schema
- evidence/attestations/README.md — expiring attestation workflow
- firebase.json — Firebase Firestore configuration
- firestore.indexes.json — explicit index configuration
- firestore.rules — deny direct client access by default
- judgment.sh — deterministic zero-model default; paid semantic review is manual-only

## Test Plan

- [x] Source PR #7 compiled and passed unit tests plus coverage before this exact source sync
- [x] Source PR #7 passed CodeQL for Actions, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Rust
- [x] App TypeScript compiled and all 11 tests passed locally, including Firestore deny-by-default
- [x] Bash syntax, JSON Schema, workflow YAML, and whitespace checks passed
- [ ] Genesis CI compiles/tests both vendored Rust crates
- [ ] Genesis compliance-audit, compliance-review-gate, dependency-review, and CodeQL pass
- [ ] After merge, run the daily dashboard workflow and inspect the new artifact

## Security / compliance notes

- Unknown earns zero; failures override passes.
- Placeholder policy evidence fails rather than inflating readiness.
- LLM review and rituals remain opt-in and are not part of the daily path.
- Durable archive writes and GCP OIDC are held for a separate explicit permission approval.
